answer: One concrete mechanism: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the ridge to sunk effort, uses the fable as an corroborating signal, then requires a pearl before any payout.
